title: The Step Stool for the Good Plates
youtube_title: The Step Stool for the Good Plates | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Helping without being asked is a quiet sort of brave.
summary: At a harbor step where parcels change hands, a step stool so the good plates could come down safely is awkward for one person. Pilar notices Papa struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
